style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens, cool veined marble #EAE6E1 for structure and scene screens, warm light board #F7F4EF for the closing scene, plus one accent-coloured headline band supplied per campaign
style.direction: clean classic kitchen-gadget commerce with one product-matched accent
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #2D2D2D inside plain circular or shield outlines, no filled gradients, no shading, each paired with an empty label slot
style.lightingSystem: bright soft neutral studio light from the upper front left with a large fill card, linear specular rolls along polished steel, skimming sweep across machined texture, soft contact shadows only and never a floating product
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean classic kitchen-gadget visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, cool veined marble #EAE6E1, warm light board #F7F4EF and charcoal text #2D2D2D, with one product-matched warm accent reserved for headline bands and short rules; bright soft neutral studio lighting from the upper front left with a large fill, linear specular rolls on polished steel and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with a bold uppercase headline and one short accent rule; thin single-weight line icons with empty label slots; stable product silhouette, angle family and scale across the set; every graphic layout keeps one clear empty copy zone; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented on-image claims.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or contradicting shadow directions
no re-scaled or re-designed product hardware
style.presentationRules: the tool keeps one consistent folded vertical silhouette for packshot and spec screens and one consistent opened diagonal silhouette for structure screens; handle shells stay a single deep tone; polished steel highlights stay linear and never blow out
style.surfaceSystem: polished cool marble counter #EAE6E1 with soft grey veining, striped waffle-weave linen towel, light end-grain wood board, plain glass and tin props with no printed artwork
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold uppercase headline with one short accent rule, all in-image copy carried only as placeholders in a reserved clear zone
